$comment: Strict TypeScript for the CLI. src/**/*.mts is the source of truth; scripts/build.mjs typechecks and emits it into the committed lib/*.mjs and bin/*.mjs. typescript and @types/node are dev-only and never ship to projects. rootDirs lets src/ import a kit hook module by the path that is right at runtime (lib/ → ../kit/hooks/x.mjs); its types come from the .d.mts beside it.
